title: Harness engineering
summary: The harness supplies the runtime, tools, state, and checks that let a model do useful work.
overview: A model needs an execution environment around it to act over multiple steps and sessions. Harness engineering shapes that environment, including startup, progress records, recovery, and evidence of completion.
why: A stronger model can still fail when it cannot reconstruct prior work or verify an outcome.
example: A coding harness restores a workspace, reads a feature checklist, runs a smoke test, and records the completed change for the next session.
judgment: Decide which invariants the runtime enforces and what evidence is sufficient to mark work complete.
next: Can a fresh session resume a half-finished task without repeating or losing completed work?
